summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing an irrevocable notice of redemption to holders of its CHF 300,000,000 0.3200% Notes due 2027 (ISIN CH1145096140, Series 47). HSBC will exercise its issuer call option under Condition 6(c) on 3 November 2026, redeeming all outstanding notes at CHF200,000 per Calculation Amount plus accrued interest from 3 November 2025 to the redemption date. Last trading day on SIX Swiss Exchange is 30 October 2026; holders look to SIX SIS AG for repayment. This is a routine liability-management call, not a special situation.
